for Collections, a live network map with a tree of every install, a Vouch connector, network monitoring alarms, provider balances and spend, email preview before taking, a louder desk ring, tickets as CSV, and workforce checks.

Portfolios: Collections accounts can be grouped into portfolios, for example a book placed by one client or a book of purchased debt. The Collections hub has a Portfolios tab, accounts can be moved into a portfolio, an import can be placed straight into an open portfolio, and the account panel shows its portfolio. A portfolio can be handed back: a preview shows what goes back, contact stops and no fees are charged after the hand-back. Reports can be grouped and filtered by portfolio.

Network map: Platform → Servers has a Map tab that draws the servers, their parts and the carriers live, and marks problems in amber or red. An Installs view shows each client install, the version it runs and whether its licence is current. Each install sends its health to the centre every minute, and a Tree view shows every install and its servers, with Yaxxa's own installs ticked.

Vouch: Vouch is in the Marketplace. After a tenant connects it with a one-time code, a call's chosen outcome sends the lead, with the customer's name and email, to Vouch.

Provider balances: SMS Portal and Clickatell show their live balance, and an alert goes out when it falls below a level you set. For WhatsApp, Meta spend is shown, and for SMPP and MTN an estimate from the messages sent and the credit bought.

Email preview: in a pick-mode email queue, an agent can preview a waiting email before taking it. Previewing changes nothing.

Desk ring: an offered call rings through the agent's headset, louder, and the browser tab title flashes. If the browser refuses the headset, it rings through the speaker.

Tickets CSV: the Tickets page has Download CSV for the tickets that match the filters.

Workforce: a special day can cover a run of dates with a Last day field, and Setup health warns when schedules are not published two weeks ahead, when coverage is short in the next 7 days or when the service level was missed.

Network monitoring: telecoms tenants can connect their network monitoring system in the Marketplace with a read-only key. Every minute its incidents become outage suggestions on the matching network area, and they clear themselves when the problem is over.

Fixes: the reassign dialog says free slots and open tickets separately, instead of showing every agent as free."}
